summary: Backend: 18/19 tests pass. Checkout status endpoint returns 500 due to Stripe 'No such checkout.session' error even when querying a session just created with same key. Frontend: Home, Catalog (style filter), Product detail, Add-to-cart, Admin login (admin@opticaari.com / OpticaAri2026!), and Admin dashboard (products/quotes/transactions tabs) all render correctly. WhatsApp float link uses wa.me/529995106899 as required.

critical.issue: Returns 500 InvalidRequestError: 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...'. The session is successfully created by POST /api/checkout/session, but retrieving status on the same session seconds later fails in Stripe. Likely the emergentintegrations layer routes create vs retrieve to different underlying Stripe accounts when STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' (proxy). Needs investigation of emergentintegrations StripeCheckout state or use a real sk_test key.

issues: Browser tab title is the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be set to 'Óptica Ari' in public/index.html

action_items: Investigate /api/checkout/status/{session_id} 500. Session was created successfully but Stripe returns 'No such checkout.session'. Possibly emergentintegrations test-proxy routing issue when reading back a just-created session. Consider catching CheckoutError and returning 502/404 gracefully, or verify STRIPE_API_KEY behavior.
Update document.title / <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html from 'Emergent | Fullstack App' to 'Óptica Ari'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_checkout uses int(round(subtotal*100)) for total_cents but then passes total_amount (float) to CheckoutSessionRequest — acceptable but ensure emergentintegrations expects decimal amount (not cents).
LoginRequest uses EmailStr but admin auth compares case-insensitively — good.
verify_admin only checks email == ADMIN_EMAIL; no expiry-specific handling distinction beyond ExpiredSignatureError — OK.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login (brute force risk).
Stripe webhook route is not protected by signature verification in code — relies on emergentintegrations.handle_webhook to verify. Ensure that lib does verification.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining backend issue is checkout/status 500. All public + admin CRUD + auth + checkout/session creation + status for paid-path code passes. Frontend admin dashboard, catalog filter, product detail and WhatsApp float verified via Playwright. Use /app/backend/tests/test_optica_ari.py as regression suite.
rca of the issue: test_checkout_status failure: POST /api/checkout/session returns a valid session_id and URL (passes). Immediately after, GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} calls stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(session_id) which throws stripe._error.InvalidRequestError: 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...'. Root cause likely in emergentintegrations StripeCheckout when STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent — the create call may use a proxied/shared key while retrieve call resolves to a different Stripe account, so the session is not findable. Mitigation: (a) verify emergentintegrations docs for correct shared-key retrieval, (b) wrap get_checkout_status in try/except to translate to 502 with helpful message, (c) use a real sk_test_xxx key for stripe.
